note: The one list of every strategy and its stage. Edit it by a reviewed pull request. It holds no live figures: names, stage, rules in plain words, dates, and an n only when it comes from public data (nBasis says which).

strategies.name: Gold closing buy
strategies.rule: Gold: about 6 minutes before each 15 minute market closes, buys whichever side costs 88c to 97c (the side the market already expects to win)
strategies.goesLive: Trial: below the research bar (the owner's written exception to the return rule, Nov 13). At most 3 contracts and no profit add-on while the trial runs. Nov 19 checkpoint of its paper record: 1.3 or better takes the normal return path (at least 60 trades and 7 days, at least 10 losses, the second half as strong, then half size for 30 trades); 1.0 to 1.3 stays at 3 contracts until 60 rows; under 1.0 the trial seat is cut
strategies.kill: Gold switches itself off if it is down more than $18 after 5 trades, if it falls $58.75 below its best point, or if its result is under -$20 after 40 trades. Any gold position that drops to 25c is sold at once
strategies.return: The same paper record clears again after the stop. It can come back by itself twice; a third stop retires it
notes: Trial: below the research bar. Trial seat from 2026-11-14: 3 contracts at most, no profit add-on, 25c early sell kept, net floor -$18 after 5 trades. Nov 19 GOLDOFF checkpoint decides the next step.

strategies.name: Open interest jump
strategies.rule: Bitcoin: buys the cheaper side at 8c to 50c when lots of new contracts were just opened, and holds it until the market closes
strategies.goesLive: Starts at 20 contracts. It steps up to 25 and 30 only when its own record and the account size allow
strategies.nextReadText: Forward read on or after 2026-11-13; the result comes by message, and the next read date follows it
strategies.kill: It stops itself after 24 losses in a row, if it is down more than $50 after 40 trades, or if it falls more than $5 a contract below its best point ($100 at 20 contracts)
strategies.return: 30 days after a stop, its paper record of new trades wins at least 1.3 times what it loses over 60 trades and holds up for 30 more. It returns at its starting size. A third stop retires it
notes: Probe since Oct 30, held to settlement; not at the research bar. Thin sample: most price-band cells read no evidence at their n

strategies.name: Release day longshot
strategies.rule: On mornings when US economic data comes out at 8:30 AM Eastern: buys the cheaper side at 5c to 50c just before that window closes, and holds it until the market closes
strategies.goesLive: Live now at 1 contract, on the listed release mornings only
strategies.nextReadText: Forward read date in the bot's registry
strategies.kill: It stops itself after 20 losses in a row, or if it is down overall after 40 trades
strategies.return: After 30 new release mornings on paper winning at least 1.3 times what it loses, with both halves positive. It returns at 1 contract. A third stop retires it
notes: Probe, 8 series at the 8:30 ET release windows; too few fills to read a profit factor

strategies.name: Gold return record
strategies.rule: Writes down the gold trades the bot would have made while gold is switched off (the side costing 88c to 97c, about 6 minutes before the close), with no money at risk
strategies.goesLive: It never trades: it is gold's paper record. Gold itself goes live again when this record wins at least 1.3 times what it loses over at least 60 trades and 7 days, with at least 10 losses and the second half as strong
strategies.label: UNPROVEN
strategies.nextReadText: Earliest return review: 7 days after the first row, and only once 60 settled rows exist
strategies.nBasis: Shadow rows the bot logs from public quotes; the count is shown from the private log, not stored here
strategies.kill: Nothing to stop: it places no order. It only keeps gold's paper record
strategies.return: Gold returns at half size for 30 trades, and at full size if those 30 don't lose money. It can come back by itself twice; a third stop retires it
notes: to confirm with the Head of R&D: first-row date (set from the registration date, not the first logged row)
strategies.roomWhat: trades toward the 60 the return rule needs

strategies.name: Perp-model longshot
strategies.rule: Bitcoin: once, 2 minutes before the close, buys the cheaper side at 5c to 30c when a price model (built from Bitcoin's always-open futures price) says it is worth at least 5c more, and holds it until the market closes
strategies.goesLive: On trial at 3 contracts. It moves to 10 contracts after 60 real trades winning at least 1.3 times what it loses (both halves holding up), then 30 more that don't lose
strategies.nextReadText: Held-out read of the research rule, once, on or after 2026-11-20. Probation fills are not research evidence
strategies.kill: It stops itself if it is down more than $18 after 5 trades, or after 30 losses in a row
strategies.return: 14 days after a slow-down stop or 30 days after a hard stop, a fresh paper record of 60 trades winning at least 1.3 times what it loses, plus 30 more at break even or better. It returns at 3 contracts. A third stop retires it
notes: Probation seat, 3 contracts, shares Bitcoin with OICORE on the same side only; no evidence of an edge at the research bar, a thin development read only
The earlier Bitcoin lead and lag variants (spot version, book version) are folded in here: they stay only as lines in the Nov 20 sitting

strategies.name: Combo house side

strategies.goesLive: Under the politics rulebook: a paper edge first, then a tiny live probe inside the $200 politics budget
strategies.label: UNPROVEN
strategies.nextReadText: Development read on or after Nov 26; held-out on or after Dec 12, only if development met the bar
strategies.nBasis: Public combo quotes recorded to the combo-data branch
strategies.kill: Paper net under -$40 at $2 a fill, or PF under 1.2 on the first 100 settled
strategies.return: The politics rulebook's: a 14 day cool-off, shadow PF 1.3+, owner approval
